description: Use this when someone asks where the Moon is right now, today or on another date: its sign (Vedic and Western), its nakshatra, its phase, or when the next full moon or new moon comes ("what sign is the Moon in today", "moon phase today", "next full moon", "today’s nakshatra", "what sign is the Moon in on 3 November"). Needs no birth details. Send the town to get the times as local clock times there; without one they are in UTC. Do not use for a person’s own Moon sign at birth: use moon_sign_nakshatra for that.

date.description: Optional: a date as YYYY-MM-DD, for the Moon at midday that day. Leave out for right now.

place.description: Optional: the town, so the times come as local clock times there.

name: moon_today
title: The Moon today
